name: memos
description: Lightweight, self-hosted note-taking service for quickly capturing Markdown notes

fields.name: WEB_PORT
fields.label: R1: Web Interface Port
fields.help: Host port used to open Memos in bridge mode. In Host Mode, Memos listens directly on NAS port 5230.

fields.name: DATA_LOCATION
fields.label: R2: Data Folder
fields.help: Bind-mounted folder that stores the SQLite database and uploaded files. Keep this folder backed up.

fields.name: MEMOS_INSTANCE_URL
fields.label: O1: Instance / Public URL
fields.help: Leave blank for a private Memos instance where anonymous visitors are sent to sign in. Set this only when you want public-facing features such as Explore, RSS, and public memo pages. Use the complete canonical address including the scheme, for example https://memos.example.com or http://192.168.1.20:5230. When using a reverse proxy, enter its public HTTPS URL.

fields.name: MEMOS_NETWORK_MODE
fields.label: O2: Network
fields.help: Choose Create New Bridge for the recommended default, Host Mode, or an existing named Docker network. Bridge mode is normally sufficient.

fields.name: RESTART_POLICY
fields.label: O3: Restart Policy
fields.help: Controls whether the container restarts automatically.

fields.name: MEMOS_IMAGE
fields.label: A1: Image
fields.help: Official stable Memos image. Change this only if you need to pin a specific release.

fields.name: MEMOS_PORT_MAPPING
fields.label: A2: Bridge Port Mapping
fields.help: Automatically generated for bridge or an existing Docker network and removed in Host Mode.

fields.name: MEMOS_CONTAINER_NAME
fields.label: Container Name
fields.help: EasyDocker sets the container name from the project name.

fields.name: MEMOS_INTERNAL_PORT
fields.label: Internal Web Port
fields.help: Recipe-managed Memos port inside the container.

fields.name: MEMOS_DATA_TARGET
fields.label: Internal Data Folder
fields.help: Official persistent data location inside the Memos container.

fields.name: MEMOS_DRIVER
fields.label: Database Driver
fields.help: This single-container recipe uses Memos' built-in SQLite database.

ui.overview: Memos is a lightweight, Markdown-native note-taking service for quickly recording and organizing ideas while keeping the data on your own NAS.
what_happens: One Memos container will be created using the stable image
The SQLite database and uploaded files will be stored in the selected bind-mounted data folder
Bridge networking is selected by default, with Host Mode and existing Docker networks also available
Leaving the Instance / Public URL blank keeps anonymous visitors behind the sign-in page
Setting the Instance / Public URL enables public-facing features and must use the real canonical address
The first account created after deployment becomes the instance administrator
ui.data_location: The selected data folder contains the Memos SQLite database and local uploaded assets. Back up this entire folder before upgrades or migrations.
